capabilities: download media files from URLs in notes
rewrite Markdown links to point at local files
store downloads in a configurable directory
process a single note via right-click menu
skip already processed notes via caching
extras: The README warns users to make backups before processing large numbers of files.
problem: Notes containing external image or PDF URLs break or go offline, and Obsidian has no built-in way to fetch those files into the vault.
summary: Media downloader that fetches images and PDFs from URLs in notes, saves them locally, and rewrites the links.
